body.x: BMW(www.bmwusa.com) announced electric car 'i3'' at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
i3 is upgrade to speed and battery life. It was mounted Lithium-ion batteries, it can be run up to 130 ~ 160km. 'Eco Pro mode' 20km service, and eco-Pro Plus mode is added more 20km speed.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance.More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
